A1.justification: Both complete 16-page PDFs describe HybridGS and include readable methods, equations, experiments, references, and supplementary Sections 7–10. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that the only visible difference is the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original HybridGS benchmark results, component ablations, qualitative reconstructions, and supplementary experiments, including Tables 1–4 and 6–7.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original HybridGS benchmark results, ablations, qualitative reconstructions, and supplementary experiments.

M1.justification: Sections 3–4 retain the same hybrid 2D/3D Gaussian representation, multi-view supervision, transient masks, losses, and warm-up, iterative, and joint training procedure.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same NeRF On-the-go and RobustNeRF scenes, the MipNeRF 360 Garden scene in supplementary Table 6, and Photo Tourism examples. The additional On-the-go visualizations are also present in both.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in corresponding experiments. Tables 1–2 retain RobustNeRF, NeRF On-the-go, 3DGS, and SpotLessSplats (SLS-mlp), with the same populated and missing entries.

E3.justification: The reported four-view setup, staged training schedules, PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS metrics, and dataset splits and resolutions in Section 9.2 are identical. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: Both contain the same component and Gaussian-count ablations in Tables 3–4, static/transient scene comparisons in Table 6, transient-mask analyses, and training-progress analyses in Figures 8 and 10.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged: both present the same point estimates and training curves without repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match. For example, HybridGS retains Corner PSNR 25.03 in Table 1 and Yoda PSNR 35.32 in Table 2; supplementary results and Table 7 efficiency measurements are also identical.

T1.justification: Equations 1–12, Gaussian definitions, projection and compositing formulations, and loss specifications are identical. No formal assumption, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same hybrid-representation novelty claim, multi-view supervision contribution, and claims of superior novel-view synthesis quality and efficiency.

C2.justification: Both retain the same explanations of transient overfitting and multi-view consistency. The illumination limitation in Section 5.4 and the interpretation of Photo Tourism results in Section 10.3 are unchanged.

D1.justification: Sections 5.1 and 9 retain identical implementation and reproducibility information, including CUDA/PyTorch, RTX 4090 hardware, 10,000 2D Gaussians per image, mask threshold 0.1, and image preprocessing. The stated project URL is unchanged.

R1.justification: Related work in Section 2, research positioning in supplementary Section 7, and all 50 bibliography entries are identical.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 5 December 2024 to v3 dated 27 February 2025. Article wording, headings, and main/supplementary organization are identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–11, Tables 1–7, captions, and page layout are unchanged. Pages 2–16 render identically; first-page pixel differences are confined to the margin version/date text.

improvement.justification: The main paper and supplementary material retain identical scientific content, evidence, explanations, limitations, and reproducibility details. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp provides no meaningful improvement or deterioration in paper quality.
